dana: heads-up — saw ~18% p95/p99 regression on qwen-14b-int8 in prod after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak. Only happens for >1024 tokens. Anyone else see this? :eyes:
sam: same in staging. traces point at KV-prefetch spikes + lots of fallback kernels. p99 went from ~210ms -> ~390ms at seq=2048.
elaine: can you paste the perf output + which quant profile you used?
dana: AWQ-8bit, calib set 'long-coverage-1k-5k'. perf snippet below:
```bash
./bench --model qwen-14b-awq --seq 2048 --batch 1 --kernel-selector auto --kv-prefetch 1
# results
p50 120ms p95 260ms p99 390ms tokens/s 85
```
Fallbacks logged: matmul->fmha, small-gemm->fallback-emu (lots of headwise->slow-path).
harry: I wired in some instrumentation — seeing RoPE scale multiplier mismatch triggering extra KV reads/evictions for long contexts. kv_cache_hit_rate drops: 0.77 -> 0.55 once seq>1024. Also head_dim path dispatch (heads=64) picked a headwise-int8 kernel that is not vectorized for this hw.
sam: that matches my microbench. Hypothesis: kernel-selector is too aggressive picking headwise-int8 for AWQ qwen when it should prefer matmul. Try forcing matmul path and toggling prefetch.
elaine: propose two quick experiments: 1) force `--kernel-selector prefer_matmul` + kv_prefetch=0 2) force headwise but enable fp8-path (if available). Measure latency + accuracy (perplexity) on the calibration prompt set.
dana: ran both tests this morning. results:
1) prefer_matmul + kv_prefetch=0 => p99 210ms, tokens/s 148, accuracy delta vs baseline +0.2% (negligible)
2) force_headwise + fp8-path => p99 350ms, tokens/s 92, accuracy delta -0.1%
Conclusion: matmul path dominates for AWQ qwen on long seqs. Turning off prefetch avoids eviction churn.
perf-bot: note — prefer_matmul increases SM utilization and memory bandwidth; cost estimate per-token changes ~-2% (improved). :chart_with_upwards_trend:
harry: suggested policy: kernel-selector should prefer_matmul for Qwen family when head_dim==64 and quant_profile==awq and seq>1024. Also add a long-context subset to the AWQ calibration prompts so quantization stats capture the longer activations.
sam: I'll add a CI microbenchmark: `bench/qwen-longseq-matmul-vs-headwise` (seq=512,1024,2048; batch 1/2). Will add perf regression alert thresholds.
elaine: also flagging that Mixtral/LLaMA families have different head_dim / RoPE scales. We should make the selector table-driven (model_family -> preferred kernels + prefetch policy) instead of hardcoded heuristics.
dana: filed INF-1234 with attached traces, bench outputs, and a short reproduce script. pinging @eng-runtime for visibility.
harry: one more small thing — add a debug metric: `kernel_selector_choice` + `kv_prefetch_evictions` to per-request sampling so we can correlate decisions with p99 spikes.
dana: thanks everyone. I'll push a short rollback patch for selector override and open a follow-up PR to implement the table-driven config. :thumbsup:
